verdict.rationale: Meltano is a CLI-first ELT platform, so API/CLI versioning and a deprecation policy are fair questions for it. The evidence pack never mentions API versioning, semantic versioning guarantees, or a deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Lack of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
